title: Quentin and the Witness
author: Juniper Reyes
blurb: August Thackeray, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
